name: PT SLJ Global Tbk
summary: PT SLJ Global Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in development and natural forests and logging and timber transportation businesses in the United States of America, East Asia, Indonesia, Europe, Australia, and Southeast Asia. The company manages forests. It also provides forests timber and non-timber products, including general, floor-base, marine, truck, container, bending, and film faced plywood, as well as truck flooring and veneer products. The company was formerly known as PT Sumalindo Lestari Jaya Tbk and changed its name to PT SLJ Global Tbk in December 2012. PT SLJ Global Tbk was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
